title: Ari — EN/IT/PT (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk acoustic guitar Italian Portuguese language learning warm female vocal 100bpm brushed drums trilingual family portrait child singer Australian hopeful
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Ten years old. Sang with a head cold.
The man who ran the venues said: wow.
Oma said: breathe when you sing.
Ari already knows how.

[Verse 2 - Italian, with English translations]
Dieci anni. Ha cantato con un raffreddore. (Ten years old. Sang with a head cold.)
L'uomo che gestiva i locali ha detto: wow. (The man who ran the venues said: wow.)
La nonna ha detto: respira quando canti. (Oma said: breathe when you sing.)
Ari lo sa già. (Ari already knows how.)
La migliore cantante di casa. (The best singer in the house.)
Suo padre lo ha detto. (Her father said so.)
A mezzanotte. (At midnight.)
Andando a letto. (Going to bed.)

[Chorus - Portuguese, with English translations]
Ari (Ari)
Dez anos (Ten years old)
Ari (Ari)
A sala ficou quieta (The room went quiet)
Ari (Ari)
Filha do Joel (Joel's daughter)
Ari (Ari)
Com um resfriado (With a head cold)
Ari (Ari)
E ainda a melhor lá (And still the best one there)
Ela vai ser famosa (She will be famous)
O pai disse (Her dad said so)
À meia-noite (At midnight)
Ari (Ari)

[Bridge - all three]
English: When you're ready, Ari. The vault is open.
Italian: Quando sei pronta, Ari. Il vault è aperto. (When you're ready, Ari. The vault is open.)
Portuguese: Quando você estiver pronta, Ari. O vault está aberto. (When you're ready, Ari. The vault is open.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Ari — she will be famous — Joel said so
Italian: Ari — sarà famosa — Joel lo ha detto (Ari — she will be famous — Joel said so)
Portuguese: Ari — ela vai ser famosa — Joel disse isso (Ari — she will be famous — Joel said so)
